title: Wide decorative quickstart frames derive a canvas from verified real photos without weakening source safeguards
steps: Run the three declared Node test suites.
expect: All tests pass with no skips. Strict crop output remains unchanged; a wide decorative gap can use a deterministic source canvas.
Large but wrong-subject, poor, poster, logo, worded, collage and unverified photographs remain rejected. Small/portrait sources remain gaps.
Foreground occupies at least half the canvas, retains at least half the source and is never enlarged. Pixel tests preserve the sharp source region and validate EXIF and actual source resolution.
WP/Joomla/EmDash integration uploads and reads back matching derivatives with source hash and recipe, keeps CSS and records real-only plus requiresReview.
fence: Source labels stay unchanged; strict matching applies to the real foreground, and renderer checks actual pixel geometry.
